summary: Phase 1 premium subscription + AdMob rewarded ads backend testing complete. All 21 tests passed (100%). Validated /api/system/pricing, /api/system/quota (free + premium), /api/system/subscription/verify (happy + 3 error paths), /api/system/subscription/restore (existing + nonexistent), /api/system/rewarded/claim (grant, cooldown, premium bypass, missing user), and full per-endpoint quota burn on /api/ai/tutor/chat (10 successful calls, 11th returned HTTP 429 with detail.reason='endpoint_quota_exceeded:tutor_chat:10/10', then rewarded bonus recovery allowed a 12th successful call). All 7 fix-files served correctly and app.json contains version=1.0.8 with versionCode=9.
critical_code_review_comments: system_routes.py + usage_tracker.py: subscription/verify is a STUB — trusts client-supplied purchase_token without calling Google Play Developer API. Already documented in docstring; must be replaced before production launch to prevent free premium via forged tokens.
rewarded/claim similarly trusts the client; SSV signature verification from AdMob is TODO and should be enforced before shipping monetization.

usage_tracker.grant_rewarded_bonus writes bonus rows but does not distinguish per-endpoint vs global consumption when computing total_today (uses get_user_bonus_today(uid, None) which sums ALL rows). That is correct for daily cap but note: bonus rows with endpoint set still count toward the 15/day global cap — matches spec.
ai_routes._guard passes endpoint to check_user_quota — confirmed enforcement path works end-to-end.
No indexes declared on user_endpoint_usage / user_bonus / subscriptions collections. Consider {uid,date,endpoint} compound index for read hotpaths as user base grows.
test_credentials: None required — all /api/system routes are unauthenticated (X-User-Id header only). Unique per-test UUIDs used to avoid cross-run contamination.
seed_data_creation: Test-only MongoDB writes into subscriptions (uid=verify-user-*), user_bonus (rw-user-*, quota-burn-*), user_endpoint_usage (quota-burn-*). All UID-prefixed with random suffixes so re-runs are idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 backend contract fully verified. Slow test test_tutor_chat_endpoint_quota_and_bonus_recovery burns 11 real GPT-5 tutor calls (~34s wall) — mark @pytest.mark.slow or --deselect if under time pressure. For Phase 2 (native react-native-iap + react-native-google-mobile-ads), focus on frontend integration + real Play Billing signature verification wiring.
